ONLINE ASSESSMENT
The online test was held on the HackerEarth platform on
August 4th. There were a total of 3 coding questions with a
duration of 90 minutes. The questions were of easy-medium
difficulty.
1. Power Limit
(20 Pts)
A and B are 2 sources given. At each round, we have to
select one source. The power of source at a time of
selection must be greater than 1. Every second, the power
of the selected source gets reduced by 2 and the unselected
source gets charged by 1. We have to stop when at least one
source has power 0.
Sample Input : 3,5
Sample Output : 6
2. Auto Suggest
(50 Pts)
You are given a query string and an array of strings. Your
task is to find the closest string to the given query string
using the Levenshtein distance. If two words have the same
Levenshtein distance, then the
lexicographically smaller word is given priority. Calculated
distance for each word given in the array with respect to the
query word and selected the minimum one.

2
Query string "apple";
String strings[] =["apples", "banana", "apricot", "grape",
"peach"]
Output: “apples”
3. Backlink Sorting
(50 Pts)
We were given an array of web pages title and array of
corresponding number of backlinks. The task was to
arrange web pages in descending order of backlinks they
have. If two web pages have the same number of backlinks,
we need to maintain the order.
Input: web-pages[] = [“A”, “B”, “C”, “D”]
Back-links[] = [10,20,5,10]
Output: “C”, “A”, “D”, “B”
I was able to solve all three questions and a total of 41 students
were selected for interviews.

Resources and Tips
●DSA : https://450dsa.com/
●OS : CodeHelp by Love Babbar
●DBMS : Roadmap by Love Babbar
●OOPS : Roadmap by Love Babbar
●CN : Gate smashers playlist
Some Tips:
●When you don’t understand a particular problem statement, do ask for
clarifications on it.
●Think out loud. This way the interviewer gets an idea about which
direction you are going.
●Always have a look at some interview experiences beforehand.
Checkout Geeks For Geeks and COC drive. Very Helpful.
●ALWAYS ASK the interviewer something when they ask you whether
you have any questions for them. It shows that you do have interest in
the company. ( Ask relevant questions only)
●Prepare for HR and Behavior questions too, we generally prepare
technically and ignore behavioral questions.
●Don’t neglect CS fundamentals and don’t leave for the end.
●Be in formal attire and posture, they notice everything while you
answer, how you entered the room, how you are leaving the room.
●Don’t lie on your resume.
●Self belief is a key. Always be confident.
KEEP CALM AND ALL THE BEST 👍🏻
For any queries reach out to me at Gmail or LinkedIn.
